description: Search upcoming Christian gatherings (services, prayer nights, Bible studies, worship nights, meals, recovery groups) posted on The Living Bread, within 250 km of a place or online, over a window of 1 to 60 days, soonest first, with paging. The general gathering search: use it for custom windows, online-only ("an online service I can join") or first-visit friendly events. For the next few hours use gatherings_tonight; for a plain this-week list use events_this_week; for church buildings use find_churches_near. days counts forward from now; online true lists only online gatherings and ignores distance; a cursor is valid only with the same city, online and days. Times are UTC: convert before telling the person. Listed times are what hosts posted, not confirmation it is happening. Empty results return count 0 and suggest online gatherings. The place words (no user id) are logged anonymously. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

city.description: A city, region or country, used when there are no coordinates: "Dallas", "Lagos", "Greater London". Geocoded to its centre.

cursor.description: Opaque paging token: the next_cursor value from the previous answer of this same call. Omit for the first page.

days.description: How many days ahead to look, 1 to 60 (default 14).

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, only if the person shared their location. Must be paired with lng; coordinates win over city.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, paired with lat.

online.description: true: only gatherings joinable online from anywhere. Omit to include in-person and online.

name: find_gatherings_near

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

count.description: Gatherings on this page; 0 when none.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

gatherings.description: Soonest first: id (fetch with gathering:<id>), title, start in UTC, city-level place or "online", distance in km, category, online flag, and whether the host marked it good for a first visit.

gatherings_page.description: Link to every gathering on the web.

honest.description: Present when count is 0: what the empty result means and what to try.

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as cursor for the next page; null when there is none.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

searched.description: The place searched, as resolved, or "online".

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: Find gatherings near a place
